name: upload-post
description: Publish to 22 platforms — TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky, Google Business, Discord, Telegram, Mastodon, WordPress and more — with long-form video, short clips, photos, carousels, text, threads and documents. Schedule cross-platform or drip through a posting queue, repurpose long videos into viral shorts with AI, run comment and review replies, build Instagram comment-to-DM funnels (AutoDMs), and track analytics. Backed by the hosted Upload-Post MCP server (50 tools, one-click OAuth, no API key to copy) plus eight opinionated skills and three subagents for content strategy, autodm architecture, and upload debugging. Free plan, no credit card required.
